releases.body:
Three new agent readers (`ante`, `doubao`, and `teleagent`, bringing `deja` to
52 coding agents), a composite GitHub Action, sub-second cold `deja recall` and
2.3 MB synced manifests via `imported.gob` and stub-based lineage scans, plus
parallel edit radar, subagent parent briefs, 2-strike fix gating, and pass-rate
ranking for verification commands.

### Added

- Three new agent readers bring `deja` to 52 harnesses (#6116, #6117, #6128, #6139). Adds Ante (`ante`, `~/.ante/sessions` JSONL/JSON stores, installer wiring, and `ante --resume`), Doubao Desktop (`doubao`, Chromium IndexedDB LevelDB stores across macOS, Linux, and Windows, from @takomitkm), and TeleAgent (`teleagent`, per-account `teleagent.db` SQLite stores, from @takomitkm), with 52-harness parity across all READMEs, registry pages, and MCP guidance.
- Composite GitHub Action (`uses: vshulcz/deja-vu@main`, root `action.yml`) installs `deja` with SHA-256 checksum verification across Linux, macOS, and Windows runners, alongside `mise` install documentation (#6121, #6126, #6130).
- Hooks track active file edits and git worktrees in a short-lived `.coord` radar to warn on parallel session collisions, and inject a bounded parent context brief when a subagent spawns (#6103).
- `commands.gob` records per-command pass and fail session counts and expands `VerifyCommand` recognition to chained, env-prefixed, path-qualified, linter, and repo check invocations so `deja how`, MCP `orient`, and post-edit hints rank commands that pass (#6105).
- `deja bench live --delivery` audits harness delivery wiring across the full catalog instead of four hardcoded agents, `deja mcp` routes omitted `mode` calls by query shape, and hook digests drop fork twins and uncorroborated hints (#6119).
- Relevance scoring and RM3 expansion preserve compound identifier segments on natural-language bug reports, recall packing prioritizes resolution turns, and `deja ctx` gates diff blocks on query-bound symbols (#6113).
- Top-fold Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode install commands in the README, live Raycast Store (`raycast.com/vshulcz/deja-vu`), Wikidata (`Q142234463`), Hugging Face dataset, and Zenodo DOI links, a ClickHouse Loom row in `compare.html` (from @zlareb1), and nested docs header links (#6096, #6122, #6127, #6132, #6137).

### Changed

- Sync import dedupe hashes move out of `manifest.gob` into an `imported.gob` sidecar and `contextByID` drops a duplicate whole-session load, cutting a synced manifest from 54 MB to 2.3 MB and `hook-tool` latency from 191 ms to 101 ms (#6136).
- Live lineage checks resolve once per `recall` or `context` call, index opening and spawn edges in memory, binary-search shared session prefixes, and read raw role and header stubs via `recoffsets.bin` instead of inflating full `records.bin` session bodies. Cold CLI `deja recall` drops from 9,039 ms to 658 ms, and warm `deja mcp` `recall` lands at 164-260 ms (#6141, #6142).
- Automatic hook `fixes.gob` hints require a 2-strike `.coord` failure streak within the same project, bypassing on first strike only for `Repaired` or `Substitute` pairs and deterministic shell, environment, CLI, or permission errors (#6110).
- Non-Claude session parsers align on explicit exit-0 command markers, incremental tail resumption, token and tool-call telemetry, and fix-pair command matching (#6101).
- Tightened the one-time interactive GitHub star prompt and dropped the rejected unscoped `deja-vu` npm publish step (#6095, #6123).

### Fixed

- `hook-prompt`, `hook-context`, and the DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin stay non-blocking under cold or rebuilding indexes by running `dsh` hooks asynchronously with bounded timeouts and respecting active rebuild locks, while unnamed session lookups without a transcript path cap fallback probes to 64 KB head/tail windows and keyed SQLite queries (#6114, #6134).
- Bare `deja show <id> --json` returns the full session when `--offset` and `--limit` are omitted while keeping `window.capped` on paged slices,

releases.body:
Built from 022bcdeb on 2026-11-21.

Unreleased code — use a tagged release unless you are testing something specific.

Download with: gh release download nightly

Six new agent readers (`clawcode`, `codearts`, `mimo`, `omnigent`, `orca`, and
`qoder`, bringing `deja` to 49 harnesses), cross-harness extraction and audit
parity, `deja audit --secrets` raw credential scanning, `deja stats --no-index`,
and bounded-memory indexing across split batches and `remineFixes`.

### Added

- Six new agent readers bring `deja` to 49 harnesses (#6028, #6046, #6051, #6059, #6060). Adds Claw Code (`clawcode`, installer hooks, `claw --resume`), Qoder CLI (`qoder`), CodeArts Desktop (`codearts`), MiMo-Code (`mimo`), Omnigent (`omnigent`), Orca (`orca`), and Zoo Code task discovery under Roo roots.
- `deja audit --secrets` and `--fail-on-secrets` scan raw stores for unredacted credentials without indexing (#6087). Also indexes Claude `auto-memory` notes and tracks all 49 registry stores (#6058, #6091).
- `deja stats --no-index` scans local agent stores with zero index writes (#6055).
- Standalone Orca (`extensions/orca`) and CodeWhale (`extensions/codewhale`) plugins, a `deja-handoff` skill, root Qwen/Codex/Skill manifests, a release `.mcpb` registry manifest, and an unscoped `deja-vu` npm wrapper (#6057, #6059, #6076, #6079, #6086).
- `PreToolUse` and `PostToolUse` catch post-edit signature changes, moved files, `PostToolUseFailure` events, and Antigravity tool failures (#6053, #6059).
- `PromptPicker` and multi-session recall ranking improve search across related sessions (#6088).
- 49-harness parity across all 12 README locales, agent memory config guides, `llms-full.txt`, and session-deletion guides for DeepSeek Harness and Devin (#6021, #6024, #6059, #6065, #6075).

### Changed

- Non-Claude harnesses share Claude's worktree and scratch-path normalization (`/.worktrees/`, `/.claude/worktrees/`, `/.projects/`, `/.jobs/`), inline command/exit/edited-file extraction, and transcript fallback project resolution (#6091).
- Cold code guards decouple from hot-path hook execution, and MCP / OpenCode recall cuts query latency (#6051, #6062).

### Fixed

- Incremental indexing holds deferred tail sessions across split sub-batches (`withoutDeferred`), splits batches with new files when no session crosses the midpoint, streams `remineFixes` one session at a time, and flushes each postings bucket during compaction before reading the next (#6078, #6089, #6090, #6091).
- MCP recall triggers proactively, excludes unstamped asking sessions, and `deja doctor` handles dead launchers and keeps `live_rules.jsonl` group-writable in shared indexes (#6045, #6056, #6067).
- Hooks scope the `.hookseen` lock to the current commit, add a `source-hints` opt-out, guard non-repo roots with edit/traceback recovery, dedupe anonymous tool calls, and measure Antigravity compactions (#6049, #6054, #6085).
- `DefaultDir` honors absolute `XDG_CACHE_HOME`, Windows Devin reads `sessions.db` from `APPDATA`, `deja rules sync` updates Hermes profile `SOUL.md` files, and `day0bench` deduplicates identical sessions across haystacks (#6050, #6064, #6083, #6084).
- OpenCode, Kilo CLI, and MiMo-Code TUI status plugins fit whole segments to the remaining footer width, yield when the session sidebar is open, and stay clear of built-in MCP, plugin, and shortcut hints (#6092).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(audit): scan raw transcripts for credentials without building an index (#6087)
* feat(claude,audit): index auto-memory notes and speed up store audit (#6058)
* feat(hook): catch post-edit sig changes, moved files, and agy failures (#6053)
* feat(hooks,search): decouple cold code guards and improve recall/localization (#6062)
* feat(mcp): add registry manifest for release mcpb bundle (#6076)
* feat(search): extract PromptPicker and improve multi-session recall (#6088)
* feat(skills): add deja-handoff skill and scope standalone deja-search (#6086)
* feat(sources): discover Zoo Code tasks under RooRoots (#6046)
* feat(sources): read CodeArts Desktop sessions (#6060) (@takomitkm)
* feat(sources): read Qoder CLI transcripts as their own harness (#6028)

Turn-0 file localization and verified target guardrails, dead-end reversal and
root-cause `FixPair` recall across marathon episodes, `deja bench live` and
`deja audit`, ephemeral `npx` launcher staging, and native IntelliJ Platform,
Neovim, CodeCompanion, and Tmux plugins.

### Added

- `UserPromptSubmit` localizes likely target files and verified test recipes at Turn 0 before the first file read. Strips `<fork-boilerplate>` envelopes and git/PR workflow footers on structured specs, matches quoted diagnostic strings and `cooccur.gob` neighbors, and attaches verified file guardrails (`standing`, `repo decision`, `reverted approach`, `prior decision`, `past breakage`) with cross-surface `.seen` deduplication.
- `PreToolUse` surfaces verified dead-end reversals with causal rationale, extracts edited symbols and root-cause explanations (`Why`) from self-corrected `FixPair` edit-test loops, and scans full episode history in 200+ message marathon sessions while blocking broad multi-file sweeps.
- `deja bench live [--json]` measures read-only `PreToolUse` actionable recall, dead-end reversals, ephemeral noise rate, and temporal Turn-0 localization replay across a repository without mutating `.hookseen` or injection logs.
- `deja audit [--json]` inspects detected agent stores for transcript counts and sizes, retention deletion risk (`cleanupPeriodDays`), preserved deleted sessions, recoverable edit paths, and wiring state, while `deja install` stages ephemeral `npx`/`bunx` binaries into persistent user storage so hooks keep working after cache eviction (#6036).
- IntelliJ Platform / JetBrains IDE plugin, native Neovim runtime plugin (`:Deja`, AI blame), CodeCompanion extension, and Tmux Plugin Manager (TPM) plugin (#6029, #6030, #6031, #6032).
- `deja sessions` records model, token usage, and tool-call counts per session (#6010).
- Memory guide for Muse Code and session-deletion guides for Grok Build, Senpi, and Command Code (#5995, #6009, #6013, #6015).

### Changed

- `deja stats` and `deja doctor` run faster on large stores, and README / translated README install instructions use OpenCode 2.x `plugin add` (#6012, #6014, #6017, #6022, #6026).
- `RecentSpokenAssistantTurnsForTerms` filters postings to spoken assistant records before applying `maxRecords`, and `UserPromptSubmit` shares candidate selection with `deja bench live`.

### Fixed

- Auto-synced `.deja/memory.jsonl` project decisions require multi-session confirmation (#6025).
- `PostCompaction` recovery preserves tail context and recent verification commands across compactions (#6019).
- JetBrains plugin drops deprecated platform APIs and passes Marketplace XML validation, and the Raycast extension unwraps v2 search hits (#6033, #6034).
- Windows ZCode detection checks `PATH` and `ProgramFiles` fallbacks for `ZCode.exe` (#6016, #6018).
- Enforced CLI boundary, environment, and parser contracts, respected shared-index modes/clients in `deja doctor`, and rejected whitespace-only paths and blank `delete` / `resume` prefixes (#5997, #5999, #6007, #6008, #6011).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(cli,docs): stage ephemeral npx binary, add deja audit, balance 43-agent positioning (#6036)
* feat(hook): turn-0 localization, target guardrails, and 0.24.2 release (#6038)
* feat(jetbrains): add IntelliJ Platform plugin (#6031)
* feat(nvim): add native Neovim runtime plugin for session recall and AI blame (#6029)
* feat(sessions): record model, token usage, and tool-call stats per session (#6010)
* feat(tmux,nvim): add TPM plugin and CodeCompanion extension (#6030)
### Fixes
* fix(cli,sources,embed): enforce CLI boundary, env, and parser contracts (#6011)
* fix(digest,search,orient): preserve tail context and recent verify commands across compactions (#6019)
* fix(doctor,delete): respect shared-index modes/clients and reject blank delete prefixes (#6008)
* fix(extensions): drop deprecated JetBrains APIs and unwrap Raycast v2 search hits (#6034)
* fix(jetbrains): replace em-dash in plugin

Repository memory (`.deja/memory.jsonl` and `deja review`), zonal BM25F and
corpus-learned collocation mining, multilingual live standing-rule and edit
guards across all 44 harnesses, Streamable HTTP MCP transport (`--http`), and
Devin CLI `PostCompaction` / Windsurf `deja rules sync` parity.

### Added

- `.deja/memory.jsonl` repository memory, `deja repo`, and `deja review` track file- and commit-linked decisions and traps. Hooks auto-seed and evolve repo memory, surfacing coupled files, caller/signature guards, test assertion predictors, and error remedies (#5964, #5981).
- Zonal BM25F field weighting and NPMI collocation mining improve multilingual recall across EN, RU, ZH, and JA. Adds 1-hop associative query expansion, Dirichlet log-odds discourse marker learning, and trajectory-verified conclusion synthesis (#5989).
- Live turn-pair refusal capture (`syncLiveSessionRules`) and edit-payload guards (`old_string` / `new_string`) work across all 44 harnesses. Covers plugin, sidecar, and deferred harnesses including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Goose, Pi, Cline, Amp, DeepSeek, OpenClaw, Hermes, Prime, and Reasonix.
- Devin CLI `PostCompaction` capture and recovery packet delivery from `sessions.db` (`compact/prior_node_ids`), plus `deja rules sync` (with Cascade's 6,000-character cap) and status bar parity for Windsurf and Kiro IDE (`docs/registry/registry.json`).
- Opt-in Streamable HTTP transport (`deja mcp --http`) and `DEJA_EMBED_BATCH` batching control (#5968, #5969).
- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) search controls with customizable keys and a scoped `/deja` command (#5978, #5990).
- SpecStory, Basic Memory, Mem0, and MiniMax Code guides (#5977, #5991, #5994).

### Changed

- `deja embed` semantic search reads only winning record offsets and calibrates the cosine floor for low-cosine models and distributions (#5979, #5980).
- Qwen Code and Gemini CLI MCP recall blocks hand off through `PostToolUse` so the TUI stays collapsed.

### Fixed

- Antigravity MCP config marks `deja` eager (`forceAllToolsEager` and `tools.deja.eager`), Kilo Code and Kiro `deja install` auto-allow `deja` (`alwaysAllow` / `autoApprove`), and Antigravity/Goose deferred hooks surface pre-edit file guards on `read_file` and `view_file` (#5987, #5992).
- ZCode Desktop 3.17+ hook wiring writes to `config.json` and `deja doctor` reads the active file (#5960, #5984).
- OpenCode session reader reads `session_v2` when the legacy table is a leftover (#5962).
- Tightened redactor patterns, friction signatures, compaction carry, recall project scoping, and duplicate hook-check deduplication in `deja doctor` (#5968, #5973, #5974, #5982, #5985, #5986, #5988).
- Shell completion for `deja last`, `deja stats`, and `deja show --offset`/`--limit` stops suggesting flags while an option awaits its value, `deja show` treats whitespace-only session IDs as missing, and `deja blame` refuses blank paths before and after `--` (#5955, #5961, #5983, #5993).

## Changelog
### Features
* feat(dsh): search controls with customizable keys and a scoped /deja (#5978) (@takomitkm)
* feat(embed): calibrate semantic floor for low-cosine models and distributions (#5980)
* feat(hooks): auto-seed repo memory and wire coupled files, file guards, and error remedies across hooks (#5981)
* feat(hooks,plugins,devin,windsurf): unify 44-harness live turn-pair rules, edit payload guards, and Devin/Windsurf parity (#6000)
* feat(index,hooks): add zonal BM25F, collocation mining, and multilingual hook guards (#5989)
* feat(mcp): add opt-in Streamable HTTP transport (--http) (#5969)
* feat(repo): add .deja/memory.jsonl repository memory and deja repo CLI
* feat(repo): auto-evolve file- and commit-linked .deja/memory.jsonl (#5964)
* feat(review): add deja review and repo-scoped rules candidates
### Fixes
* fix(blame): refuse a blank path before and after -- (#5993) (@Sharawey74)
* fix(completion): leave last and stats option values alone (#5983) (@rajshadow)
* fix(completion): offe
